name: Mochizuki Nanami
source: Mochizuki is the school idol for her good looks and athletic ability. Her fame has lead her to get a fan club that is often called the guard because of how unfriendly they are to people who try to get close to her. Because  they follow her as much as possible she often on the move or hiding to get her own privacy.
